title: Variability analysis - 3SE
description: Analysis of a system of interest to determine what system variants can be derived from it, considering feature variants, system attribute variants, system activity variants, system activity attribute variants, system function variants, system function attribute variants, system state variants, system state attribute variants, functional element variants, functional element attribute variants, functional interface variants, functional interface attribute variants, physical element variants, physical element attribute variants, physical interface variants and physical interface attribute variants.
